questions.question: Explain the difference between a variable and a constant.
questions.correctAnswer: A variable is a named memory location whose value can change during execution. A constant is a named value that cannot be changed once set. Constants prevent accidental changes and make code more readable.

questions.question: Write pseudo-code that asks for a number and outputs "Positive", "Negative", or "Zero" using selection.
questions.correctAnswer: INPUT number IF number > 0 THEN OUTPUT "Positive" ELSEIF number < 0 THEN OUTPUT "Negative" ELSE OUTPUT "Zero" ENDIF

questions.question: When would you use a REPEAT...UNTIL loop instead of a WHILE loop?
questions.correctAnswer: Use REPEAT...UNTIL when the loop body must execute at least once (e.g. input validation). Use WHILE when the loop may need to execute zero times (e.g. searching a list that might be empty).

questions.question: Write pseudo-code using a FOR loop to output all multiples of 3 from 3 to 30.
questions.correctAnswer: FOR i ← 3 TO 30 STEP 3 OUTPUT i NEXT i

questions.question: Write pseudo-code that keeps asking for a password until the user enters "open123", then outputs "Welcome".
questions.correctAnswer: password ← "" WHILE password <> "open123" INPUT "Enter password: ", password ENDWHILE OUTPUT "Welcome"
